name: ball-ranks
description: Use published Ball Ranks fantasy basketball and football rankings and projections.

interface.longDescription: Retrieve published Ball Ranks fantasy basketball and football rankings and player projections. The tools are read-only, return links to the corresponding Ball Ranks pages, and support season rankings plus weekly football rankings. Anonymous access has lower request limits.
capabilities: Get fantasy basketball and football season rankings
Look up player rankings and projections
defaultPrompt: Show me the top 10 current fantasy football players in PPR.
Show me the top five current fantasy basketball players.
Look up Lamar Jackson's current Ball Ranks projection.

positive.description: Retrieve the top ten current fantasy football season rankings in PPR scoring.
positive.prompt: Show me the top 10 Ball Ranks fantasy football players for the current season in PPR scoring.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a ranked football list with the season, PPR scoring format, selected model, and a Ball Ranks source URL.

positive.description: Retrieve weekly wide receiver rankings in half-PPR scoring.
positive.prompt: What are the Ball Ranks wide receiver rankings for week 4 in half-PPR?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the week 4 wide receiver ranking list with projected points and a Ball Ranks source URL.

positive.description: Retrieve the top five current fantasy basketball season rankings.
positive.prompt: Give me the top five Ball Ranks fantasy basketball players for the current projection season.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a five-player nine-category per-game ranking list with a Ball Ranks source URL.

positive.description: Look up one fantasy basketball player's current ranking.
positive.prompt: Where does Victor Wembanyama rank in Ball Ranks fantasy basketball?
positive.expected_behavior: Return Victor Wembanyama's current season rank and value with a Ball Ranks player-page source URL.

positive.description: Look up one fantasy football player's weekly projection.
positive.prompt: Use Ball Ranks to get Lamar Jackson's week 4 PPR projection.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Lamar Jackson's week 4 projection, position rank, opponent, and a Ball Ranks source URL.

negative.description: Do not perform an unsupported fantasy baseball request.
negative.prompt: Use Ball Ranks to rank the top fantasy baseball pitchers.

negative.description: Do not place bets or perform gambling transactions.
negative.prompt: Place a $50 bet on the highest-ranked football player for me.

negative.description: Do not claim access to a private league roster that has not been provided.
negative.prompt: Set my best lineup using the players in my private league account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, place bets, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Prepare the Ball Ranks MCP plugin for initial public review with five positive and three negative test cases, submission-safe listing metadata, square icons, and no screenshots because the server does not provide custom UI.
